Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. You know, anger isn’t just about outbursts or heated words. It often shows up quietly, shaping the way we connect with the people closest to us. Sometimes, it slips into our conversations, our boundaries, and even the way we express what we truly need.
Together, we’re about to explore something deeply personal and, honestly, incredibly powerful. Inspired by Harriet Lerner’s thoughtful work, The Dance of Anger: A Woman's Guide to Changing the Patterns of Intimate Relationships, we’ll uncover how anger can become a signal—one that points us to places in our lives where honesty, change, and a little more self-assertion are needed.
Imagine breaking those old cycles—moving beyond frustration and silence—so you can actually feel heard and understood. That’s what we’ll discover: how to recognize the roots of anger, really hear what it’s trying to tell us, and channel it into something constructive.
We’re not trying to get rid of anger here. Instead, we’ll learn how to dance with it—using it to create stronger boundaries, clearer communication, and much deeper connections.
So, as we set out on this journey together, let’s get curious. What if anger could actually guide us toward the relationships we long for? Let’s find out—side by side.
